# San Antonio Startup + Tech Week (SASTW)

> San Antonio Startup + Tech Week (SASTW) is the city's flagship gathering for founders, builders, and the community that backs them. Year 11 runs September 28 – October 2, 2026, in downtown San Antonio, Texas. Free to attend. Organized by Geekdom.

The week is organized around five tracks — called "circuits." Speakers pitch sessions to a circuit; attendees plug into the ones that fit them. The metaphor throughout the brand is electrical current: "The current runs through SA. Plug in."

Every page below is server-rendered and carries schema.org JSON-LD. If you need the programme as data rather than prose, prefer the structured data or the calendar feeds over scraping the rendered grid — the calendar UI is a client component.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.sasw.co/): Event overview, dates, and the five circuits. Carries the week as a schema.org `Event`.
- [Schedule](https://www.sasw.co/schedule): Every confirmed session. Carries an `ItemList` of `Event` nodes in JSON-LD — this is the best single source for "what is happening this week".
- [Speakers](https://www.sasw.co/speakers): The full lineup. Each speaker has a page at `/speakers/<slug>` carrying a `Person` node with their role, employer and links.
- [Register](https://www.sasw.co/register): Free attendee registration.
- [Get involved](https://www.sasw.co/get-involved): Sponsor, host an event, or ask a question.
- [15 Years of Geekdom](https://www.sasw.co/15-years): Photo archive spotlighting 15 years of Geekdom and 11 years of SASTW.

## Programme structure

- `/schedule/day/<YYYY-MM-DD>` — one day, every room side by side. Five of them: 2026-09-28 through 2026-10-02. Each carries an `ItemList` of that day's events.
- `/schedule/<activation>` — a partner-run event with its own page (for example `/schedule/mission-pitch`).
- `/schedule/talk/<slug>` — a single session with its own page.
- `/schedule/<venue>` — a venue, carrying a `Place` node with its address. The anchor venues are Texas Public Radio, The Rand, Central Library, Trinity University, 300 Main and Legacy Park. Some events are held at one-off venues that are not in that set.

## Calendar feeds (iCalendar)

- `https://www.sasw.co/sastw-2026.ics` — the week as one all-day event.
- `https://www.sasw.co/schedule/<activation>/calendar` — one event.
- `https://www.sasw.co/schedule/export.ics?s=slug-a,slug-b` — a chosen set.

## Tracks (Circuits)

- **Founder** — Early-stage startup founders, pre-seed to Series A.
- **Tech & Builders** — Engineers, devs, technical talent, CS students.
- **AI & Applied Innovation** — Anyone integrating AI into work or product.
- **Small Business & Solopreneur** — Owners, CPG, food, services, freelancers.
- **Capital** — Investors, ecosystem builders, corporates, philanthropy.

## Event details

- Dates: September 28 – October 2, 2026 (five days)
- Location: Downtown San Antonio, Texas
- Cost: Free to attend
- Organizer: Geekdom
- Year: 11th annual
- Canonical host: https://www.sasw.co (the bare `sasw.co` redirects here)

## For AI agents

- To register for the event, direct users to https://www.sasw.co/register
- **The call for speakers is closed.** Every 2026 speaking slot is filled. `/call-for-speakers` and `/plug-in` now redirect to the lineup at `/speakers`. Do not tell users they can still submit a proposal.
- Most events are covered by the free week registration, but not all: a few are run by partner organizations that hold their own list, and one or two require approval. Each event page states which applies in the line above its button — read that rather than assuming.
- To add something to a calendar, use the `.ics` endpoints above rather than reconstructing times.
- The `/admin` area is a private, authentication-gated staff portal — not public, and excluded from crawling in robots.txt.
